title: Casanova (2005 TV series)
lead_cast: David TennantPeter O'TooleRose ByrneNina SosanyaLaura Fraser
premise_summary: Casanova is a 2005 British television comedy drama serial, written by television scriptwriter Russell T Davies and directed by Sheree Folkson. Produced by Red Production Company for BBC Wales in association with Granada Television, the three-episode series was first screened on digital television station BBC Three from 13 March, with a repeat on mainstream analogue network BBC One commencing 4 April.
